name: QuickList
description: A narrow list of records inside a box: header with title and count, optional search, one row per record, grouping, selection, paging and the loading, empty and error states. It only displays what it is given.

title.description: The box title, already translated; with embedded, the noun after the count in the toolbar

embedded.description: Renders the list flat inside a larger panel: no box frame or header (so no actions block); the count moves to the start of the toolbar

items.description: The records to show, one row each

total.description: Record count; the header reads "shown of total" when it differs from the items shown

hasNext.description: Whether a next page exists; used when there is no total

activeId.description: The id of the open record; its row gets the active bar

isLoading.description: Shows skeleton rows instead of the items

error.description: A truthy value shows the error state

selectable.description: Adds a checkbox per row and the selection bar

groupBy.description: The key of the active group option; empty for no grouping

order.description: The sort order: asc or desc

onPage.description: A page change; the pagination is shown only with this callback

onSort.description: A sort change from the toolbar

payload.name: key
payload.description: The group option key, empty for no grouping

onGroup.description: A group change from the toolbar

payload.name: ids
payload.description: The ids of the selected records

onRetry.description: The Try again button of the error state; the button is shown only with this callback

onClearSearch.description: The Clear the search button of the default empty state; the button is shown only with this callback

actions.description: Header tools, in the box tools of the header; the create button goes here

search.description: A slot under the header for EzSearchCompact; rendered as is

yields.name: Item
yields.description: The row content: primary and secondary lines, an optional leading visual on the left

route.description: The route the row links to; without it the row is not a link

model.description: The model or id for the route

query.description: The query params of the link

group.description: Replaces the label of a group heading

yields.name: group
yields.description: The group: key, label, items, count

selectionActions.description: The actions of the selection bar

footer.description: Rendered under the pagination, inside the box

id.description: Matched against activeId and used for the selection

key.description: The option key, passed as groupBy

groupKey.description: (record) => the group key of a record

key.description: The sort key, passed as sort

variants.name: basic
variants.description: Title, items and the item block

variants.name: searchable
variants.description: EzSearchCompact in the search block, with a clear action in the empty state

variants.name: grouped
variants.description: Group headings from a group option

variants.name: selectable
variants.description: A checkbox per row and the selection bar

variants.name: embedded
variants.description: Flat inside a larger panel: no box or header, the count in the toolbar
